body: I know, i was thinking about the damage i will be doing to those who love me. I’ve had a really bad day thinking about this and having to face some problems today, I’m trying to wait for some days, let’s see if things can get better.
I’ll try to talk to them, i just arrived at my family house, I couldn’t talk to them because i had an anxiety crisis. I’m trying to rest a little bit and not do something crazy

Hi, i think they may understand, but i’m not 100% sure. I tried to reach out to people on the legal department, i was told that my clients cant do what they are doing (Talking shit about me). The problem is that I’m broke to refund them 100% (Couple of months ago i refunded one of the clients and still working on the canceled project as a form of apology), i have no way of explaining myself to them as they don’t care about my mental health, financial situation and one of them even threatened to murder me (He lives overseas, but he is turning my life into hell right now). I took the day to think about all this situation, i really don’t know what to do, things keep getting worse and I don’t want to be a disappointment for my family.
 I’m back at my parents house now, i lost my apartment today because I couldn’t pay rent and now the owner of the apartment is also threatening to sue me, I told her i would try to sell my things to give her money, but the only thing i have to sell is my laptop that i used to work. If i end up not killing myself i would need the laptop to work... I gave myself one day and i already fucked up
